gold_notes: The third-quarter 2014 earnings release (accession 0001104659-14-073810) does not print Keytruda sales (the product is not on its sales table; its text reports the 4 September 2014 FDA approval and first shipments only). The fourth-quarter and full-year 2014 release prints Keytruda's four 2014 quarters as separate columns of the same sales table: 0, 0, 4, 50 and a full year of 55 (the printed full year is one more than the quarters' sum, a rounding difference). The third quarter of 2014 is the 3Q column of that row (the third of the four quarterly columns). Merck's quarterly earnings release (8-K exhibit 99.1) prints this product on its own 'Keytruda' line of the multi-column sales table (worldwide sales, USD millions, no regional split; columns are the current-year quarters and year-to-date, then the prior-year quarters, then percentage changes). The line is Merck's worldwide sales of Keytruda (pembrolizumab) and carries no footnote adding other products. From the fourth-quarter 2025 release Merck prints the intravenous product on a 'Keytruda' line and the subcutaneous product on a separate 'Keytruda Qlex' line, and the summary table headline becomes 'KEYTRUDA/KEYTRUDA QLEX'; this series is the 'Keytruda' line only, whose earlier values are unchanged, and it excludes Keytruda Qlex sales.
